title: petrobras walks back gasoline price hike says tax cuts will lower pump prices 2026 09 10
text:
SAO PAULO, Sept 9 (Reuters) - Brazilian state-run oil firm Petrobras (PETR3.SA)
, opens new tab
 said on Thursday that a package of government ​tax measures will result in a 0.19 real ($0.0372) reduction ‌per liter in gasoline prices for consumers, reversing an earlier announcement that had implied a raise in prices to distributors.
($1 = 5.1102 reais)
